LEGO 10348Manual steps 1–5

Bonsai pot assembly

Inspector

Action timeline

0 = initial state · n = after action n

Recorded rail construction and installation

In each fixed cohort of 22 matched native recordings, 18 exceeded the stored skin-penetration limit and four were within it. Assessed active contact had 18 pad-gap exceedances and four films without values. Each contact-mode capture failed the reviewer’s strict-invocation check despite a complete video.

The 10348 evaluated mesh reaches 17.1 mm of inter-hand penetration at frame 885 and 47.0 mm below the tabletop under the left hand at frame 898. The images show overlapping hands and a flattened pose. The depth of a hidden surface is a geometry measurement. Exact forces and downstream guidance accuracy were not measured.

Fixed sample for this edition: 22 matched movies and 5,098 source frames.

10348-1 · manual_prefix_05 · Exact input · Producer · Encoder · Recording details

88.50 s The hands overlap. A dark patch appears and clears.

89.70 s The left hand looks flat against the table and then lifts.

101.20 s The fingers largely obscure the joint.

Hand visibility and rail seating

Foreground hand at the camera

  • 56.5 s · frame 565 · As the left hand sweeps close to the camera, a solid black polygon enters from the left and covers much of the lower-left foreground. Source PNG
  • 56.6 s · frame 566 · A large, flat black polygon sits at the end of the foreground finger-like shape. The colored build is hidden behind the shape. Source PNG
  • 56.7 s · frame 567 · The black patch has disappeared in the next frame. The extended left fingertips still cross the foreground as the colored base comes back into view. Source PNG

First rail seating

  • 94.6 s · frame 946 · Both hands overlap directly over the work. The lower separate gray strip is still visible, but the incoming rail’s contact with the center is hidden. Source PNG
  • 95.3 s · frame 953 · The right fingers open sharply compared with the previous frame. The yellow section and a gray studded edge reappear beneath them. Source PNG
  • 96.8 s · frame 968 · With both hands clear of the center, one gray rail is visible across the far side. A second separate rail is still below the left hand. Source PNG

Second rail seating

  • 101.2 s · frame 1012 · The right thumb and hand cover the near edge of the colored base while the left index approaches from the other side. Neither underside nor exact stud engagement is visible. Source PNG
  • 102.4 s · frame 1024 · The right fingers begin to clear the near edge, revealing the second gray strip and its lighter end studs opposite the first. Source PNG
  • 103.4 s · frame 1034 · Both hands have withdrawn from the build. The near and far gray rails remain in place around its colored center. Source PNG
